Name: Nyapu Style Kids for the School Portraits by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
This is a portrait replacement for the "Kids of the School" in Nyapu Style.

Thank you to [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193928383-n3cro92/]N3cro92[/url][/b] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for allowing me to use their work.

[b]INSTRUCTIONS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [b][url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193928383-n3cro92/]N3cro92[/url][/b] for writing the CP code! Now, all you have to do is unzip and drag it into the Mods folder. No replacement is required!

[s]You should be able to unzip this file and drag it into your Mods folder.
It should prompt you to replace the files.
If you need the file path it's
[CP]Kids for the School\[CP] Kids for the School\assets\CharacterFiles\OverworldSprites\ (Then each character
has their own folder)[/s]

[b]COMPATIBLE[/b]
Kids of the School
Kids of the School- Lazy
Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic


If you would like to know how the progress is going on the rest of my Nyapu-Style Portrait retextures please check out my social media or nexus profile page.
